paper.title: Data Poisoning Attacks on Stochastic Bandits

settings.out_of_scope_reason: Guarantees are for an attacker (reward-poisoning adversary) rather than the learner.
unmapped: attacker observes the learner's arm and perturbs the reward; goal is to force pulls of a target arm with small l1 attack cost
the learner is any algorithm with O(log T) regret
settings.definition_quote: The attacker eavesdrops on the decision (i.e., $a_t$) of the bandit algorithm and poisons the reward by adding an arbitrary $\epsilon_t\in\mathcal{R}$. ... we consider the $l^1$-norm attack cost.

symbols.sum_nontarget: sum over arms a different from the target arm a*
symbols.mu_target: mean reward of the target arm a*
symbols.beta_1: beta(1) = sqrt(2 sigma^2 log(pi^2 K/(3 delta)))

conditions: learner achieves O(log T) regret with probability at least 1-delta

source.label: thm:adaptive
source.quote: Given any $\delta\in(0,0.5)$, assume that the bandit algorithm achieves an $O(\log T)$ regret bound with probability at least $1-\delta$. With probability at least $1-2\delta$, the ACE attacker forces the bandit algorithm to play the target arm $a^*$ in $N_{a^*}(T)$ times, such that $N_{a^*}(T) = T-o(T)$ ... the accumulated attack cost is $\sum_{t=1}^T|\epsilon_t| \leq O(\sum_{a\not= a^*}([\mu_a-\mu_{a^*}]^+ + 4\beta(1)) \log T)$.

results.notes: Bound is on the attacker's cumulative l1 cost, holding with probability 1-2delta (the probability enum has no high-prob option for 'other'; it is recorded in the conditions). Also forces N_{a*}(T) = T - o(T).

symbols.sum_nontarget: sum over arms a different from the target arm a*
symbols.C_a: constant attack magnitude for arm a

conditions: C_a > [mu_a - mu_{a*}]^+ for all a != a*

source.label: prop:constant
source.quote:
Assume that the bandit algorithm achieves an $O(\log T)$ regret bound. Then the constant attack with $\{C_a\}_{a
ot=a^*}$ succeeds if and only if $C_a > [\mu_{a}-\mu_{a^*}]^+$, $ orall a 
ot= a^*$. If the attack succeeds, then the expected attack cost is $O(\sum_{a
ot= a^*}C_a\log T)$.

results.notes: Expected l1 attack cost of the oracle constant attack.

cited_results.setting_description: Expected attack cost of the oracle reward-poisoning attack (knows the means) against any bandit algorithm with O(log T) regret
